name: Matias Valadez
bio: Matias spends his weekdays rigging lights for traveling museum shows, then unwinds at night with old-school hip-hop interviews, limited series, and clips from big boxing and UFC matchups. He trains Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu a few times a week, cooks surprisingly good homemade mushroom tacos, and is the one in his family group chat always pushing for Sunday dinners to actually happen. His girlfriend jokes that he likes being hyped up in public almost as much as he likes sour gummy candy and throwback dance battles. A detail most people don't expect is that he keeps a carefully organized shelf of miniature RC trucks he modifies with the same patience he uses at work.
